text: Next, we will insert the 3-volt button battery into the Battery ePod.
Use the 3-volt button battery from your kit. Keep the printed, shiny side facing up.
The Battery ePod has a battery holder. The battery will be placed into this holder, which keeps it in place.
Align the battery with the circular battery holder.
Now lower the battery straight down into the holder, with the printed side up.
Gently press the battery down until it sits properly in the holder. The holder locks the battery in place.
The 3-volt battery is now inserted in the Battery ePod, and it is ready to be connected.
